title: Sense Unassigned Load Growth
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sense:device device_name="Other"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(power_w) as other_power_w by home _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(other_power_w) as baseline_w by home
| where baseline_w>0 AND other_power_w>baseline_w*1.2
| sort - other_power_w
description: Uses Sense device detections telemetry to monitor the share of power still hidden in unassigned loads in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for homes where device detection has drifted backwards, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Sense device detections data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly trend of Sense Other load.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds the share of power still hidden in unassigned loads so you can spot homes where device detection has drifted backwards before it becomes annoying.
